name: CluckTalk
short_description: A voice farm manager for broiler poultry farmers: shed status, daily briefing, feed and sale plans, health checks.
full_description:
CluckTalk is a voice farm manager for broiler poultry farmers in India, with a Telugu subtitle (kodi mitra) on its cards. It answers by voice and, on a screen, shows a bilingual Telugu and English card.

What it does in the current build: shed status (one shed or the whole farm), a ranked daily briefing, a feed plan for the week, a sell-day plan, a voice record book, a health check that tells you how urgent signs look and what to check first, a follow-up question the day after a check, and a hand-off message to your vet.

Safety: it never gives a medicine or a dose. For anything urgent or a suspected reportable disease it says to contact your vet.

Simulated in the demo: market prices, sensor readings, the supplier, SMS and payments are simulated and always labelled Simulated.

Status: in development. It has been tested against a local copy of the documented flow and with its own simulator; it has not been run on an Alexa+ device.
example_phrases: When should I sell shed one?
How much feed does shed two need this week?
